manifest.name: Kin Battleship
manifest.purpose: Naval Battleship with animated seas, ships and sound. A hit earns another shot. Play the computer free (no credits), or your Kin (uses credits). Also playable in chat.

actions.name: battleship_new
actions.description: Start a new game of Kin Battleship with the person, right here in chat. Use when they want to play Battleship or a new game of it. A hit earns another shot; a miss passes the turn.

actions.name: battleship_turn
actions.description: Use each time the person calls a cell like B5. A hit earns another shot: if they hit, pass only their next call as shot. If they miss, pass their call as shot and yours as my_shot. If you hit, fire again — pass follow-up cells in my_shot or the app aims them.

shot.description: the person's call, like B5. If they just hit, this is their next shot and you don't fire yet.

my_shot.description: your call at their fleet, like G7, only when they miss or it's already your shot. If you hit you fire again: you can pass follow-up cells, like G7, G8.

actions.name: battleship_board
actions.description: Use when the person wants to see the boards or the score of the Kin Battleship game.

actions.name: battleship_quit
actions.description: End the Kin Battleship game without a winner, when the person wants to stop playing.

actions.name: battleship_record
actions.description: Records a game finished on the Kin Battleship screen and tells the Kin how it went.

manifest.name: KinTouch
manifest.purpose: Link your toy through Lovense Remote and let your Kin start, pattern or stop it, from chat or the KinTouch screen's own chat, using your own Lovense developer token.

actions.name: link
actions.description: Make a new code to connect the person's toy in Lovense Remote. Use when they want to connect or reconnect it.

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Check whether the person's toy is linked and connected. Use when they ask if it's working.

actions.name: start
actions.description: Turn the person's toy on with one kind of motion (vibrate, rotate, pump, thrust and so on) at a strength 0-20 (pump and depth 0-3) for 1-60 seconds. Use when they ask you to turn it on, go harder or softer, or take over.

action.description: The kind of motion, in any wording: vibrate, rotate, pump, thrust, fingering, suction, oscillate, depth, or all. Vibrate if unsure.

actions.name: pattern
actions.description: Play a built-in rhythm on the person's toy: pulse, wave, fireworks or earthquake, for 1-60 seconds. Use for variety or when they ask for a pattern.

kind.description: pulse, wave, fireworks or earthquake; pulse if unsure

actions.name: ramp
actions.description: Smoothly raise or lower one motion on the person's toy from one strength to another over 1-60 seconds. Use to build up or ease off.

action.description: The kind of motion, in any wording: vibrate, rotate, pump, thrust, fingering, suction, oscillate, depth, or all. Vibrate if unsure.

actions.name: steps
actions.description: Play several strengths of one motion one after another on the person's toy (up to 8 steps, 120 seconds in all), like a little routine you choose. Use when you want to tease, build or vary things over time.

action.description: The kind of motion, in any wording: vibrate, rotate, pump, thrust, fingering, suction, oscillate, depth, or all. Vibrate if unsure.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Stop the person's toy right now. Always use this when they say stop, wait, enough or anything like it.

actions.name: callback
actions.description: Show the Callback URL to paste into the Lovense developer dashboard.

actions.name: chat
actions.description: Talk with your Kin on the KinTouch screen; it can answer and work the toy.

actions.name: clear_chat
actions.description: Clear the KinTouch chat.
